venture.name_status: Descriptive label only; no business name supplied
venture.concept: A refrigerator/device that displays food temperature, estimates remaining freshness, offers preservation guidance, and adjusts cooling.
venture.primary_product: Smart refrigerator; full refrigerator assumed for this pricing study
venture.target_customers: Homeowners ages 25–80, any gender, especially health-conscious shoppers and people replacing an older or unreliable refrigerator. Income range unspecified.
venture.value_proposition: Help households manage food freshness and waste through understandable food information and cooling controls. Benefits are proposed, not validated.
venture.geographic_market: Eastern United States initially; eventual North American expansion
assumptions: Full refrigerator rather than retrofit device is the comparison basis. Capacity and installation format remain unspecified.
Competitor customer segments and positioning are analyst interpretations of features and price, not measured demographics.

comparison.basis: One representative offer per brand; USD one-time appliance price before additional charges. Indicative cross-channel comparison includes P04 Partially Verified and P01 business terms.

preliminary_pricing_recommendation.status: Preliminary strategic hypothesis, not optimal price
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.rationale: Near the $3,199 LG cooling/convenience benchmark and $3,499 GE Kitchen Assistant offer, extending to the $3,799 Samsung business-channel benchmark only if item-level freshness guidance is independently demonstrated.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.positioning: Near the sampled premium smart-fridge alternatives; lower than their displayed reference anchors. Not a budget-market claim.
conditions: Confirm retail checkout benchmarks and local availability
Validate sensing, prediction accuracy and usability before premium claims

research_limitations: Only three deliberately selected brands and five offers; not a market census or demand study.
One representative offer per brand prevents over-weighting brands with more recorded variations.
GE prices are retailer observations, conservatively Partially Verified; Samsung is a business-channel benchmark, not a confirmed household checkout offer.
Prices are dated observations and may change. ZIP-specific stock, taxes, shipping, installation and checkout eligibility were not tested.
Reference prices are advertised anchors, not evidence of historical transactions. Regular-price fields remain null.
Capacities, depth and features differ. Per-refrigerator prices compare purchase budgets, not equivalent performance.
Food-specific sensing, reliable spoilage prediction and autonomous preservation were not demonstrated by this research. Do not promise elimination of food waste or food-safety guarantees.
No manufacturing costs, willingness to pay, service costs, margins or break-even analysis were supplied.
Venture name, channels, size and whether product is a retrofit device remain unresolved. A retrofit would require separate research.
Prior workspace Reddit counts and fictional focus-group comments were not independently revalidated or treated as pricing evidence.
